INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
